items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring, Q) is working out pregame vs Cowboys; true game-time decision but team is not counting on him playing.
items.why: Pregame workout to determine availability; source says team not counting on him.
items.implication: High risk of inactive; monitor 90-min window closely for Ravens WR depth.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Ravens pass-catchers if out.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (hip, Q) plans to play / good to go vs Cardinals, per source.
items.why: Plans to play confirmed by source; aligns with Levitan projection.
items.implication: Clear for start; full or near-full role expected.
items.opportunity: Maintains WR target share in SF offense.

items.text: Eagles Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially good to go / off injury report for MNF vs Bears; Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.implication: Full go for key PHI skill players.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams ruled OUT for MNF vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent full participant/Q and returning to practice.
items.implication: Bagent start; impacts CHI pass-catchers (Odunze hate by Berry).
items.opportunity: Potential checkdown/TE uptick; lower overall efficiency.

items.text: Colts place Alec Pierce on IR; Josh Downs target share jumped to 36% after Pierce exit, now more perimeter routes.
items.why: Official IR; prior usage shift noted by Berry.
items.implication: Downs WR3/flex upgrade with expanded role.
items.opportunity: Higher target share, routes from multiple alignments for Downs.

items.text: Jayden Daniels officially OUT (elbow); impacts WAS passing game and McLaurin outlook in tough SEA matchup.
items.implication: Mariota start; Berry hates McLaurin this week due to matchup + low total.
items.opportunity: Reduced overall offense; McLaurin still sees targets but lower ceiling.
items.conflict: Berry notes McLaurin value not completely tanked long-term with Mariota history.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite Q tags; hoping early clarity on Flowers (ham), DJ Moore (shoulder), AD Mitchell. Big DFS main-slate implications.
items.why: Usage/opportunity data and practice trends support playing; field concerns overblown for some.
items.implication: Start Warren/Evans/Bowers with confidence if active; fade if late scratch.
items.opportunity: Warren lead + checkdowns with Dowdle out; Bowers TE volume return.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries: IN (Dobbins, Harvey, Nabers, Etienne, Price, Darnold, Murray, Jones); Q (Bowers, Flowers, Evans, DJ Moore, Warren, Pittman, Coker); D (Nacua); OUT (Daniels, Collins, Dowdle, Pierce, Brooks, Iosivas, Coleman, Dart, Njoku).
items.why: Comprehensive Fri/Sat list for Sunday slate; key clarity on roles.
items.implication: Immediate start/sit and beneficiary shifts across multiple teams.
items.opportunity: Snap/target/carry bumps for backups and complementary pieces.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT; elevates Jaylen Warren to lead role with checkdown upside in PIT backfield.
items.implication: Warren clear RB1/volume play; strong start.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps, carries, targets, third-down work for Warren.

items.text: Puka Nacua DOUBTFUL (hip); monitor for inactive, with potential WR upside to Adams/Whittington if out.
items.why: ETR list and reports indicate unlikely.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for Adams and other LAR WRs.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks to IR/OUT; Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back (RB14 util through 2 wks) with AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: IR expected after limited games; Hubbard already leading util.

items.text: Nico Collins OUT; Dalton Schultz saw 28-30% target share / targeted on 30% routes last week without him; faces IND allowing 4th-most TE yards.
items.why: Confirmed OUT; prior-week usage spike documented.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share, routes, red-zone looks for Schultz.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup + volume projection; feed him.
items.opportunity: Heavy carries, goal-line work vs weak front.

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
LOVE Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.opportunity: High target share and deep opportunities.

items.text: LOVE Dalton Schultz (@IND, Collins out boost) and Christian Watson (vs ATL, WR8 util, 38% RZ share, WR9 PPG since Wk11 last yr).
items.opportunity: Schultz target share; Watson RZ/red-zone looks.

items.text: HATE Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches; JAX stout vs RBs) and Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara).
items.why: Role/volume concerns + tough matchups; Henderson out-touched post-fumble.
items.opportunity: Henderson narrowed gap but Stevenson still ranked ahead by Berry; Etienne limited role.
items.conflict: ETR has Etienne IN; usage still split.

items.text: HATE Terry McLaurin vs SEA: fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total (17) with Daniels out.
items.why: Brutal matchup + low team total + QB change.
items.opportunity: Historical Mariota target share exists but this week suppressed.
